from enum import Enum
import threading


class Course:
    class Status(Enum):
        Open = "Open"
        Full = "Full"

        def __str__(self):
            return self.value
    class MessageQueue:
        def __init__(self, ready):
            self._calls = []
            self._ready = ready
            self._stopped = False
            self._condition = threading.Condition()
            self._worker = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=False)
            self._worker.isIdle = False
        def start(self):
            self._worker.start()
        def put(self, call, *args):
            with self._condition:
                self._calls.append((call, args))
                self._condition.notify()
        def stop(self):
            with self._condition:
                self._stopped = True
                self._condition.notify()
        def _run(self):
            while True:
                with self._condition:
                    call = None
                    while not self._stopped:
                        call = self._next()
                        self._worker.isIdle = call is None
                        if call is not None or self._unreachable():
                            break
                        self._condition.wait(0.25)
                    if self._stopped or call is None:
                        return
                call[0](*call[1])
        def _next(self):
            for i, call in enumerate(self._calls):
                if self._ready is None or self._ready(call[0]):
                    return self._calls.pop(i)
            return None
        def _unreachable(self):
            ended = (threading.main_thread(), threading.current_thread())
            return not ended[0].is_alive() and all(t in ended or t.daemon or getattr(t, "isIdle", False)
                for t in threading.enumerate())

    def _canProcess(self, call):
        name = call.__name__
        return (self._status is __class__.Status.Open and name in ("_register",)
            or self._status is __class__.Status.Full and name in ("_reject",))

    def __init__(self):
        self._eventQueue = __class__.MessageQueue(self._canProcess)
        self._status = None
        self._deleted = False
        self.setStatus(__class__.Status.Open)
        self._eventQueue.start()

    def getStatusFullName(self):
        answer = str(self._status)
        return answer

    def getStatus(self):
        return self._status

    def _register(self):
        if self._deleted:
            return False
        wasEventProcessed = False
        aStatus = self._status
        if aStatus is __class__.Status.Open:
            self.setStatus(__class__.Status.Full)
            wasEventProcessed = True
        return wasEventProcessed

    def register(self):
        self._eventQueue.put(self._register)

    def _reject(self):
        if self._deleted:
            return False
        wasEventProcessed = False
        aStatus = self._status
        if aStatus is __class__.Status.Full:
            self.setStatus(__class__.Status.Full)
            wasEventProcessed = True
        return wasEventProcessed

    def reject(self):
        self._eventQueue.put(self._reject)

    def setStatus(self, aStatus):
        self._status = aStatus

    def delete(self):
        self._deleted = True
        self._eventQueue.stop()
